sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Suzu (鈴) is a character from Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying manga series.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Suzu is the older sister of Shoukichi. She lives in a village nested between the mountains of Ashina with Shoukichi and her son Choukichi. While gathering mushrooms in the mountain, she gets kidnapped and used as test subject for the red eyes. Because of the red eyes power, she loses her mind and is killed by Hanbei to put her out of her misery.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 1
sections.text: Suzu finds Shoukichi who had just attacked Hanbei the Undying. She scolds him, since Hanbei could be a guest of Takamine. Seeing that Hanbei is still alive, she takes him to their house and treats his wound, and feeds him. After Shoukichi leaves to fight some brigands, Suzu explains that her father and her husband died in wars, and she fears that if another war starts now, she will lose Shoukichi and eventually Choukichi. Hanbei then thanks her and leaves.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 2
sections.text: After Hanbei saves Shoukichi, but gets killed, Shoukichi brings him back to their house and asks Suzu to take care of him. Suzu wonders what he means as Hanbei is dead, but as she looks at him, Hanbei wakes up, which scares her. Soon after that, Hanbei leaves and Suzu thanks him for saving Shoukichi and explains that he can stay longer and since its getting dark, he could get spirited away in the mountain. However Hanbei still leaves, but soon returns as Shoukichi asks him for a favour to find the missing people in the mountain.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 4
sections.text: Suzu welcomes Shoukichi and Hanbei back from the mountain and is glad to see Shoukichi alive.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 5
sections.text:
While giving Hanbei a haircut, she tells him that if he keeps making scary faces, Choukichi won't ever approach him. While they eat, Hanbei tells Suzu to not go deep in the mountains as there may still be danger. Suzu tells Choukichi that Hanbei is a good person and Choukichi gives him some of his food.
Suzu gathers some mushrooms in the mountain. She is able to find only poisonous, but guesses that Hanbei will be alright. She then goes a bit deeper into the mountain to look for more.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 8
sections.text: Suzu get kidnapped and used for red eyes experiments by Doujun. Hanbei comes to save her, but Suzu had lost her mind due to ingesting rejuvenating water and gaining red eyes. Initially Hanbei leaves, but returns moments later and kills her to put her out of her misery.
